written: 2026-11-03, before research/notebooks/value_scale_cost.py existed and before any of its runs
about: Phase B, B1 (research/value-scale-plan.md): what each mistake costs. v4.1 runs on every bank table under each reading and, with a log reading, each meaning of a 0. The result fixes the reading the service uses on 'can't tell' and whether a protein 0 is missing under both readings. Not edited after the run: a difference is explained in the report.
tables: every bank table, traced as Phase A traced it (vsd.traced_table: the service's validation, at most 2,000 cells with D3's seed); plus pxd064083_union, the T and B tables side by side (the genes either reports, NaN where one lacks a gene), since the two tables alone are narrow uploads
pipeline: v4.1, modality prot, pipeline.run_projection with stated_scale and stated_zeros

conditions.log_zeros_measured: stated_scale log, zeros measured (today's reading of a table it calls log)

right_reading: the bank label: linear tables -> linear; log tables -> log_zeros_missing (identical to log_zeros_measured when the table has no 0; the bank's log tables with zeros, furtwangler_log2 and furtwangler_log2_raw_sn, use 0 for 'not measured': the authors' own _nan layer has missing values exactly there)

measures.changed_best_guess: share of cells whose best-guess class differs from the right reading's
measures.changed_answer: share of cells whose answer (label and level, or no answer) differs from the right reading's
measures.answered: share of cells with an answer
measures.accuracy: where labels exist: balanced accuracy of the best guess over coarse groups with at least 5 cells, a guess right when its COARSE type (benchmark/fulcher2026_score.py) is in the cell's group; CD4 T and CD8 T form one group T. Labels: pxd064083_union (sorted T or B), fulcher_tmt (the authors' coarse annotation; Unknown left out), pbmc240_diann (the authors' marker-based labels: T cell, NK cell, Dendritic, Monocyte; unassigned and Platelet left out). Khoury 2026 stays sealed: no accuracy.

rows.B1_invariants: every table x condition the pipeline accepts: the stage invariants hold (value_scale_diagnostics._reading_invariants: no +-inf after Stage 0, Stage 0's missing values as expected, mask sum, z-score mean 0 and SD 1 or a constant gene 0, prepare_query equal to the trace, finite encoder input, v4.2's protein query reading as Stage 0) and every cell has a label or an abstention reason
rows.B1_refusals: linear is refused (NotIntensities) exactly on the tables with a negative value
rows.B1_direction: the median changed_best_guess of log tables read linear is below that of linear tables read as log (log_zeros_measured, today's misread)
rows.B1_log_read_linear_small: the median changed_best_guess of non-negative log tables read linear is at most 0.10
rows.B1_zeros: on the tables with at least 5% zeros, read as log: zeros missing changes fewer best guesses against the right reading than zeros measured, on a majority of them
rows.B1_accuracy: on each labelled table, the right reading's accuracy is at least the wrong reading's minus 2 points (linear tables: against log_zeros_measured)

decisions_by_rule.cant_tell_reading: linear if the median changed_best_guess of log tables read linear is at most that of linear tables read as log (log_zeros_measured); log otherwise
decisions_by_rule.zeros: a protein 0 is missing under both readings if B1_zeros holds; otherwise a 0 stays measured under a log reading, as today

expected_decisions: cant_tell_reading linear (a log of log2 values is near a straight line within a gene, which the z-score removes); zeros missing under both readings
